tasks.pages: OUT_DIR=docs MEDIA_BASE=media COPY_MEDIA=1 deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run --allow-env scripts/generate.ts
tasks.test: env -u GEMINI_API_KEY -u GEMINI_ENRICHMENT_TOKEN -u ENABLE_GEMINI_ENRICHMENT -u DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run --allow-env=PATH,FFPROBE_PATH tests/*_test.ts
tasks.browser: env -u GEMINI_API_KEY -u GEMINI_ENRICHMENT_TOKEN -u ENABLE_GEMINI_ENRICHMENT -u DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN deno run -A tests/browser_flow.ts
tasks.check: deno fmt --check README.md DEPLOY.md deno.json server.ts deploy.ts lib scripts tests extension public && deno lint server.ts deploy.ts lib scripts tests && deno check server.ts deploy.ts lib/*.ts scripts/*.ts tests/*.ts
